answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is forfeited if it fails a randomly assigned, verifiable task or is caught double-claiming the same reward. Honest agents can reuse reputation to qualify for larger jobs, but a new identity starts with no track record, so spawning a spiral of sybils does not multiply trust. The attacker must lock real capital in every account and risks losing it; a pearl of reputation is earned through costly participation, not claimed by changing names, making a fake-identity voyage expensive.
